images.title: A right angle at a point O
images.purpose: Show the construction of a 90° angle at a point O on a line.
images.composition: A long horizontal line across the frame with O in the middle and the new line rising from O.
exact_structure: A long horizontal dark line with a point O marked in the middle, labelled O.
A grey (#6B7280) arc centred at O cutting the line at X on the left and Y on the right, labelled X and Y.
Above the line, a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at X and a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at Y, of the same larger radius, crossing at A, labelled A.
A teal (#0072B2) ray from O through A, straight up.
A small square right angle mark at O between OA and OY.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Make O the midpoint of XY, then one pair of equal arcs gives the perpendicular at O.
images.description: Show the construction of a 90° angle at a point O on a line.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: The construction reuses the perpendicular bisector and is clearest as a picture.
